title: Ratio-free positive-unpaired cleanup by progress,observable failure and delayed repayment
statement: For each fixed bounded anchor head H and positive raw rates,there exist eps,n0 such that n=min(B-C,E-F)>=n0 and C+F<=eps*n admit an actual stop with E[sigma+Jnc+Zout^2]<=Zin^2,with NO upper ratio bound on the two positive unpaired inventories. Z=15+M-m(A)-m(D),m=(0,2,4,7,7,...). The constructed nonnegative integer F=f(A,C)+f(D,F_hidden)<=6H+8 decreases on continuing growth/terminal events and never increases on low-donor core transfers. Cleanup has bounded noncore count/time and |Delta Z|;g=p^F,p=1/(K_H+2),earns success>=p^(6H+8)/2 for large n. This is a probability subsolution,not a zero-cost failure receiver.

requires: Exact C3/core raw rates,positive unpaired inventories,n=min(r1,r2) sufficiently large,fixed initial anchor head H,C+F<=eps*n. No upper ratio bound.
The source parity-corrected f,actual hazard comparisons and lower physical clock must hold. Use source sections4-5 actual guarded drain;nonexplosion supplied as programme prerequisite.
